items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Paul and Jimmy Garrison sounded great and we never played with Jimmy before

ctx.x: You and Warne sound as good together as you always did.

Sometimes, yeah. Paul and Jimmy Garrison sounded great and we never played with Jimmy before and I don’t remember any discussion about tunes with original lines like that and he plays through them like he’d been playing them a while, you know? As did Gene Ramey. I don’t know that he ever . . . maybe when they were sitting in the restaurant he was talking about some changes or something, Lennie with Gene, but otherwise he’s playing through it like a total professional.
Yeah. Most of those tunes even the Tristano lines were on changes that good professional players of that era were expected to know.
